# The Tormont 50

> A consultancy group built for boards, CEOs, and investors. We don't just measure performance — we create alignment, resolve disconnects, and design strategies that build long-term shareholder trust and value.

- Website: https://thetormont50.com/
- Contact Email: info@tormontgroup.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/thetormont50page/
- Full Documentation: https://thetormont50.com/llms-full.txt

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://thetormont50.com/): Overview of The Tormont 50, core capabilities, evolution, podcast spotlight, 5-step process, differentiators, and industry partners.
- [About](https://thetormont50.com/about): Our evolution from a market ranking platform into a shareholder-focused consultancy for boards and CEOs.
- [Process](https://thetormont50.com/process): Our 5-step methodology — Discovery, Audit, Rapid Resolution, Design, and Feedback Loop.
- [Services](https://thetormont50.com/services): Capital advisory, shareholder value audits, governance alignment, rapid resolutions, and continuous alignment.
- [Leadership](https://thetormont50.com/leadership): Executive team and advisors leading The Tormont 50.
- [Contact](https://thetormont50.com/contact): Reach our team, explore FAQs, or book a Discovery Call/Offsite.
